name: presenter-garage
description: Read a ProPresenter 7 library and edit its slide text: search, read presentations and playlists, read the configured groups and macros, run text checks, audit the media bin, preview themes, and change lines once you confirm them.
long_description: Reads ProPresenter 7 files from disk, through the same decoding and checks as the Presenter Garage browser app. List and search presentations, read their slides line by line with each slide's group and macros, read ProPresenter's configured groups and macros, run the Presentations text checks, read or audit the media bin, read the presentation playlists, and list themes and preview giving a presentation one of their looks. It can also edit slide text: you are shown every line as it is and as it would read, and can untick any, before anything is written; each file is backed up outside your library first. Turn on Read only and it never writes a file. It reads nothing outside the folders you choose.

library_folders.title: ProPresenter folders
library_folders.description: The folder holding your Libraries and Playlists, usually Documents/ProPresenter. From ProPresenter 22 it is a workspace folder instead, under Library/Application Support/RenewedVision/ProPresenter/Workspaces, whose slide text is edited only while ProPresenter is closed. Nothing outside the folders chosen here is read.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Never change a file. The tools that edit slide text are then not offered at all.

tools.name: list_presentations
tools.description: List presentation files, by name or by when they were last shown.

tools.name: read_presentation
tools.description: Read a presentation's slides line by line, with each slide's group and macros, and its dates, notes, CCLI details and arrangements.

tools.name: read_groups_and_macros
tools.description: Read ProPresenter's configured groups and macros, with names exactly as stored.

tools.name: search_text
tools.description: Find a phrase in the slide text of every presentation.

tools.name: check_presentations
tools.description: Run the Presentations text checks on a file, a folder or every library.

tools.name: read_media_bin
tools.description: Read every playlist in the media bin and the items in it.

tools.name: audit_media_bin
tools.description: Find duplicates, empty playlists, hidden items and other media bin problems.

tools.name: read_playlists
tools.description: Read the presentation playlists: every service and the songs, headers and media in it.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List the themes and the slide styles each offers.

tools.name: preview_style
tools.description: Preview giving a presentation the look of a theme slide or another slide, without changing it.

tools.name: plan_slide_edits
tools.description: Work out changes to slide text, line by line: changing, removing or adding lines, without writing anything.

tools.name: apply_slide_edits
tools.description: Apply planned slide text changes once you confirm each line, backing up every file first.
